name: incident_severity
description: Grade an alert's severity for an on-call engineer

question.instructions: How severe is this production alert for the on-call engineer?
criteria: Low: informational or cosmetic; no user impact; can wait for normal working hours.
Medium: degraded experience or risk for a small set of users; fix within a day.
High: significant feature broken or many users affected; needs attention within the hour.
Critical: full outage, data loss, or security breach; page everyone now.
